candidates.change_summary: Removed the require restricting withdraw to Owner, allowing anyone to call withdraw and drain the contract to Owner address.
Require that caller is NOT the Owner, flipping the access control so only non-owners can call withdraw.
Change transfer target from Owner to msg.sender so caller receives the contract balance.
Change transfer amount to a fixed constant (1 wei) instead of the full contract balance.
Add a guard that requires contract balance to be nonzero before transfer, preventing zero-value transfers.
Swap order of require and transfer so transfer executes before the ownership check (will revert due to require after sending).
